title: Chocolate Crusted New York Cheesecake
description: Dense New York cheesecake on a chocolate graham crust, baked an hour and left to cool slowly in the oven so it sets without cracking.

imageCredit.author: zingyyellow
imageCredit.title: Baked cheesecake with raspberries and blueberries

steps.heading: Prep
steps.text: Set the filling ingredients out to come to room temperature. Heat the oven to 350°F and grease the bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan.

steps.heading: Crust
steps.text: In a food processor, combine the graham crackers, sugar and cocoa powder, then move to a medium bowl. Add the butter slowly and mix until the texture is even — it should clump together and hold its shape; if not, add a little more butter. Press firmly into the bottom of the pan, spreading evenly and keeping the sides clean. Set aside.

steps.heading: Filling
steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the cream cheese and sugar evenly (with an electric mixer, only until smooth — over-mixing whips in too much air). Add the milk, vanilla and sour cream and mix by hand until incorporated. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing by hand between each. Add the flour and mix by hand until smooth.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Set the springform pan on a cookie sheet. Pour in the filling and smooth the surface with a spoon, then tap the pan for a bit to bring air bubbles to the surface. Bake for 1 hour.

steps.heading: Cool Slowly
steps.text: Turn the oven off and leave the cheesecake inside with the door closed for about 5 hours. Once cool, remove the pan sides and slide onto a serving dish. Refrigerate at least 4 to 5 hours more before serving.

notes: For a regular crust, leave out the cocoa and sugar and use only 2 to 3 tbsp butter. Chocolate chips or other mix-ins can be stirred into the filling after the flour.
